item.title: The Shark That Roared – Watch the trailer for the indie documentary about Jaws: The Revenge
item.description: 1987’s Jaws: The Revenge was the fourth and final entry in the franchise. Directed by Joseph Sargent, the 1987 sequel saw Ellen Brody (Lorraine Gary) move to the Bahamas, where she meets Michael Caine and….wait for it…she encountered another great white shark! item.title: 1000 Women In Horror – A Celebration of Women-Led Horror gets a trailer
item.description: A deep dive into how women pioneers revolutionized horror cinema through their groundbreaking work as directors, actors and creators since 1895, leaving an indelible mark on the genre’s evolution. Directed by Donna Davies, the documentary is based on the book by Alexandra Heller-Nicholas. It features interviews with Roxanne Benjamin, Akela Cooper, Mary Harron, Cerise Howard, […]
